actions.description: The Business Case establishes a grounded value premise tied to hypotheses, credible ROI/benefit expectations, realistic risk assessments, and sound business alternatives -- approve it to authorize project chartering
The Business Case fails to justify investment, presents unviable economics or unsubstantiated value premises -- reject it outright
The Business Case requires further financial justification, risk quantification, or clearer hypothesis-to-benefit linkage before it can be judged

metadata.decision_context: Given a drafted Business Case or Benefits Statement, decide whether to approve it to justify investment, reject it, or request revision before deciding -- validating Stage 4 Benefit

complexity_profile.rationale: Defaults to true for every policy in this template, learned from a real correction (ADPA's own approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
